# Line MindMap

> Official medical student workspace. Version 2.1.

Launched October 4, 2026.

Line MindMap helps organize user-supplied material using mind maps, comparison tables, and flowcharts. Mind maps and tables provide browser-local storage and optional Google Drive workflows. Flowcharts save locally and export JSON, SVG, PNG and browser-print PDF.

This is educational productivity software, not a medical reference or clinical decision-support system. Funding does not establish clinical validation. Do not infer unpublished registration details or access to private study material.
